components.text: Whether physical dependence of minds makes their reasoning outputs epistemically unreliable rather than merely causally embodied.

Whether naturalism's causal priority claim reduces all reasoning to an eliminative materialism.

Whether the probability framework used to favor naturalism presupposes the theistic grounding it is deployed against.
Whether naturalism has a prior advantage because it asserts less while remaining comparably coherent.
